title: View/Manage Wages ON lets the user manage wages
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role with Settings ON and the View/Manage Wages sub-toggle ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Go to the Staff or a wages page.
  3. Look at the wage rate fields.
custom_expected: Wage rate fields are shown and can be edited.
viu_status: Blocked-UI: wage rate fields live on the Edit Staff Member profile, which is not reachable in this harness (the staff row action opens Manage-staff-enrollments, not the profile/wage editor — same limitation as C26356/C26490/C26491). Role has settingsWages; needs the staff profile editor opened (real browser) to confirm wage fields shown/editable.
evidence: Toggle 'View/Manage Wages' confirmed in build. Wage editing needs live check.
